description: National U.S. inpatient hospital length of stay and mean cost per stay for sepsis (principal diagnosis), by patient population and year, 2016-2021, from AHRQ HCUP Statistical Brief #306. This is the only public AHRQ cross-year table found that reports a 2021-specific national figure. Separately reports any-listed-diagnosis sepsis stay counts (a broader population than principal diagnosis) for the years AHRQ printed a figure (2016, 2019, 2021).

period.description: Reporting period. "y2021" is the full-year 2021 estimate (with and without a co-occurring COVID-19 diagnosis combined). Defaults to "y2021".
